name: intertitle-strip
title: Storyboard without screenshots
subtitle: intertitle panels only — a runnable smoke test, no images needed

panels.title: Panels are uniform
panels.body: Every panel keeps the same aspect, so the grid never wobbles.
panels.caption: Set panelAspect (default 1.6) once for the whole story.

panels.title: Captions carry the plot
panels.body: One or two sentences per panel — the pictures carry the rest.
panels.caption: Long captions wrap on their own; keep them under four lines.

panels.title: Errors get a stamp
panels.body: kind: error turns the frame red and labels it.
panels.caption: Use it for the scenario that goes wrong.

panels.title: Fixes get one too
panels.body: kind: fix is the green version of the same thing.
panels.caption: Add "image" plus a "crop" to any panel to drop an annotated screenshot in.
